# OMP Session Gateway

> Native integration with stock Oh My Pi (OMP) >= 18.1.20. No OMP fork, custom build, gateway-specific OMP plugin or publisher credential. v0.9.1 is qualified for stable promotion; publication is pending. The separate gateway discovers collaboration-enabled sessions and opens OMP's encrypted View/Control client. Setup requires collab.autoStart, Bun 1.4.4, gateway installation and TUN-mode Tailscale Serve with Funnel disabled. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by the Oh My Pi maintainers.
<!-- release-generate:summary:end -->

## Supported platforms

- Supported (tested in CI on every change, with daily stock-OMP canaries on Linux and Windows, and bug reports accepted): Linux, macOS, and Windows gateway hosts; Chrome and Chromium, Edge (through Chromium), Firefox, and Safari and WebKit browsers; and Android. Tested as a browser in CI WebKit emulation: iPhone and iPad. Supported and Tested do not imply hardware qualification; Qualified is the exact matrix below.

## Current qualification boundary

<!-- release-generate:boundary:start -->
v0.9.1 is qualified for stable promotion; publication is pending. [Release v0.9.1](https://github.com/carrythroughsystems/omp-session-gateway/releases/tag/v0.9.1). Signed candidate v0.9.1-prealpha.5; source f5167aebbeb28f9d8e484c25c28a69312b5a4167; archive SHA-256 9216835ab4683ff799e89320b80fa589530de6ca7472ddc6ea3cef96eceb2cbb. Published v0.9.0 remains the predecessor. Stock OMP v18.17.0 (75e7801e247d4e3263439d4cc08ccad60dc64bdd), Bun 1.4.4. All thirteen lanes passed; attempt counts and measured evidence are in the [release ledger](https://github.com/carrythroughsystems/omp-session-gateway/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_STATUS.md). Stable publication and published-byte smoke are pending.

- artifacts (1 attempt): Signed tag, checksums, GitHub attestations 3/3 and Sigstore bundles 3/3; v0.9.0 verified the same way.
- debian (1 attempt): Run 42325397119 succeeded (https://github.com/carrythroughsystems/omp-session-gateway/actions/runs/42325397119); OS/kernel versions and migration counts are not exported.
- macos (1 attempt): VirtualMac2,1, macOS 27.0 arm64; doctor 18/18, rollback 23/23; native addon c7ea1c80d3177ba15f5e69b81b2817b56e56465b96d5ce0293bc5c0f5294be5c.
- ompPublication (1 attempt): Stock OMP v18.17.0; generation 1; publication, View/Control, new-generation/fork/resume and revocation.
- android (1 attempt): Pixel 8 Pro, Android 17 build CP3A.261005.005, Chrome 156.0.8078.79; same-page unlock 7,143 ms, Airplane 4,129 ms, Doze 108 ms; 7/7 detectable; clean.
- androidPush (1 attempt): Android 17, Chrome 156.0.8078.79, installed WebAPK; force-stop delivered_while_force_stopped, Doze delivered_after_doze_exit; outcomes are observed variants, not delivery guarantees.
- androidPushCleanup (1 attempt): Device, browser and fixture restored.
- deviceCloud (1 attempt): TestingBot, tunnel 4.9: iPhone 17 Pro Max (26.6, safari 26.6.1); TestingBot, tunnel 4.9: iPad (9th generation) (26.6, safari 26.6); TestingBot, tunnel 4.9: Galaxy S26 (16.0.0, chrome 145.0.7632.159). Home Screen alerts were proven only on the TestingBot iPhone and do not qualify lock-screen presentation.
- deviceCloudCleanup (1 attempt): Restored.
- relay (1 attempt): 1,800 seconds, 2026-11-07T01:50:59.932Z–2026-11-07T02:20:59.946Z; 2 transitions, final phase live. Eight-hour endurance is not claimed.
- cleanup (2 attempts): Zero gateway processes, listeners and live OMP hosts.
- windows (1 attempt): Windows x86-64 build 26100; 4 CPUs, 8,186 MiB; Administrator upgrade/rollback from v0.9.0 and fresh standard-account lifecycle; interactive logon, not unattended boot.
- windowsCleanup (1 attempt): Zero instances and firewalls; tailnet node deleted and access vault removed.

The Mac guest does not qualify physical firmware, FileVault, Secure Boot or startup before login. Cloud devices qualify the browser, not phone-owned Tailscale identity; iPhone Home Screen alerts do not qualify lock-screen presentation. Gateway rollback does not switch OMP. Other hosts and browser builds remain outside this exact matrix. Portal Tunnel and self-hosted/proxied relays are unsupported.

## Fork-era release history

- Published v0.3.0 requires its exact patched OMP v18.1.14 and historical instructions; none of its qualification transfers to mainline.
